The Best Weed Dispensary In Mount Pleasant, Michigan

High Society Cannabis in Mount Pleasant is a top-tier vertically integrated weed dispensary, renowned for its exceptional customer service and extensive selection of high-quality cannabis products. By controlling every step of the cannabis journey—from cultivation to retail—High Society ensures unparalleled quality and consistency.

Our dispensary selection features popular brands such as 710 Labs, Breeze, Camino, and Crude Boys, celebrated for their superior craftsmanship and potency. This commitment to excellence has established High Society Cannabis as a preferred destination for the best weed in Mount Pleasant.

First-Time Customer Guide

  1. Who Can Shop

    Recreational shopping is available for individuals aged 21 or older.

  2. Check In

    Upon arrival, present a government-issued ID or passport and check in with the security and front desk team.

  3. Stay in the Loop

    Provide your phone number and email to stay informed about exclusive deals and discounts.

  4. Meet Your Budtender

    A budtender will call you from the waiting area when it’s your turn. They will assist with selecting products and answering any questions, whether you’re new or a returning visitor.

  5. Choose Your Items

    Once you’ve made your selections, the budtender will alert the order preparation team. Payments can be made with cash, credit, or debit cards.

  6. Complete Your Purchase

    When your order is ready, a staff member will call your name, process the payment, and review your items to ensure accuracy before completing the transaction.

How to Place an Order for Dispensary Pick-Up

  1. Browse the Menu

    Browse our Mount Pleasant dispensary menu online or contact us at (989) 317-0290 if you need assistance.

  2. Build Your Order

    Choose your preferred products, set the quantities, add them to your cart, and select a convenient pick-up time.

  3. Check Out

    Complete your order by providing your details. First-time visitors must present a valid ID for verification, while returning customers can log in for faster checkout.

  4. Curbside Pickup

    Interested in curbside pickup? Let us know, and we’ll notify you via text when your order is ready for pickup.

  5. Enjoy Responsibly

    Enjoy cannabis responsibly. We’re committed to ensuring a seamless and stress-free shopping experience!

Frequently Asked Questions

More questions? Visit our FAQ page.

What are the requirements to shop at High Society Cannabis Mount Pleasant?

To make a purchase, you must present a valid government-issued ID confirming you are 21 or older. Individuals 18 and above with a valid medical marijuana card are also eligible to shop.

What should I do if I receive a defective product?

If there’s an issue with a product’s quality or functionality, please contact us at (989) 317-0290 or visit the store where you purchased it. Our team is happy to help.

Do you accept credit cards or mobile payments?

At High Society, we accept cash and debit payments. While credit cards are not accepted, an ATM is available for convenience. Some stores may support mobile payment options—confirm with your nearest dispensary location.

Is it legal to transport cannabis?

While cannabis purchases are legal in Michigan, federal law prohibits transporting cannabis across state lines. Please avoid taking cannabis products out of the state.

What products are available at the dispensary?

We offer a variety of premium cannabis products, including flower, pre-rolls, concentrates, vape pens, edibles, and more. Check out our menu or contact us with specific questions.

What rewards program does High Society offer?

We offer The Society, a loyalty program designed to reward our customers. Earn points on purchases and redeem them for discounts and offers. Check with our staff to learn how to join.
